messages.subject: 502 Error for my first shinyapps
parts:
Hello, I am currently getting a 502 error when I deploy my app, even though it deploys locally fine on shiny() runApp()

I deployed it last night and saw it working, but when I checked back the next morning it had an error that was something like "too long to load"

I've redeployed tonight and despite the console deployment messages saying its ok, still getting a 502 here:
https://mark.shinyapps.io/GA_timeseries/

I tried again and got this error:

> library(shinyapps)
> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Waiting for task: 29072
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 12591
  building: Pushing image: 12591
  deploying: Creating Container Id: 12093
  deploying: Starting Container Id: 12093
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 29077 error: Unhandled Exception: DockerError: start: Cannot start container a01f90539aef62db179159d9a59b5d973cd5b1fc66f2c874bb0bcde9a04f5ff1: The container failed to start due to timed out.

What is preferred if I get an error like this - should I redeploy or send a quick post here?

Also I have another deployment at https://mark.shinyapps.io/menutest/ which now also seems to be down to 502, should I limit deployments? Do my apps share resources?  The second app may have been a bit more resource heavy.

All taken in stride as its Alpha, its a dream to get this all running smoothly so keep up the good work, hope the above helps :)

Yours sincerely,
Mark
